Host on GitHub Pages & Install on iOS iPhone

Zero-backend static PWA architecture designed for GitHub Pages & iOS Safari

1. Copy or Download GitHub Repository Files

Select any file below to copy its complete source code and paste directly into your GitHub repository (Add file → Create new file), or download the files to commit:

2. Use as Full-Screen App on iOS iPhone
  • Step 1: Open your hosted GitHub Pages URL (`https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/`) in Safari on iPhone.
  • Step 2: Tap the iOS Share icon at the bottom of Safari and choose "Add to Home Screen".
  • Step 3: Launch CutSync Studio from your iPhone Home Screen — it opens in full-screen standalone mode (`apple-mobile-web-app-capable`), and tapping Replace Active Cut or Auto-Fill Gallery Media opens your native iOS Photo Library / Camera Roll directly!
